title: Git repos
offline: The Machine is offline. You can change repos when it is back online
unsupported: The Runtime on this Machine has no git broker yet. Update the Runtime to set repos

missing.title: Agent not found

repos.heading: Repos it may use
repos.footer: The Agent can clone, fetch and push only these repos, through a broker on the Machine that holds the token, so the Agent never sees it. It can push only branches under veeloe/{{id}}/, and cannot delete a branch, push a tag or touch main
repos.emptyDetail: This Agent can't use git with GitHub

add.heading: Add a repo
add.footer: Type owner/name or paste a GitHub link. The Machine needs a token, set with veeloe git token on that computer
add.label: Repo on GitHub
